correctness.rationale: If \(r\) old coordinates stay at least \(K/(\alpha r)\), the next \(r\)-th order statistic qualifies, so the new rejection count is at least \(r\) and its cutoff is no larger; every old rejection therefore persists. For sharpness, starting with exactly \(r\) coordinates at the old cutoff and outsiders zero, lowering one coordinate to any smaller value makes rank \(r\) fail, every lower rank fail because its threshold is strictly larger, and every higher rank fail at zero. The affine rule is predictable, stays above the lock pathwise, and has conditional expectation at most the current e-value. A fresh bounded replay independently checked persistence and the one-coordinate collapse for every \(2\le K\le8\) and all ranks.

final_claim: For base e-BH with current nonempty rejection size \(r\), the current cutoff \(c=K/(\alpha r)\) is the sharp coordinatewise persistence floor: keeping every old rejection at least \(c\) guarantees pathwise nonrevocation regardless of outsiders, while lowering one old coordinate below \(c\) can erase all rejections. The affine update \(E^+=c+(E-c)X\), with nonnegative conditionally valid e-factor \(X\), preserves both the floor and null supermartingale validity, and \(c\) is the minimal uniformly safe lock when \(X\) may be zero.
